cocopi.subagents.description: Experimental subagent model/effort matrix. Configure visually in Cocopi settings. Explicit models remain allowed; this is not a total token budget.

cocopi.apiBaseUrl.description: Base URL for the ChatGPT Codex backend API.

cocopi.authMode.description: Credential source for extension runtime requests.

cocopi.chatInstructions.description: Custom instructions to apply to Cocopi chat requests according to cocopi.chatInstructionsPlacement.

cocopi.chatInstructionsPlacement.description: How to place cocopi.chatInstructions relative to the source chat instructions after regex replacements are applied.
enumDescriptions: Append custom instructions after the source instructions.
Use only custom instructions.
Ignore custom instructions and send only the source instructions.

cocopi.chatRegexFlags.description: Regex flags used for Cocopi chat instruction and tool description replacement maps.

default.When you ARE done, first provide a brief: When you are done, call task_complete with the complete user-facing answer in its summary field. That answer is shown to the user as the final response after the tool succeeds. Include the requested explanation, code, links, and caveats, or the work outcome and validation as appropriate. Keep useful progress updates during work, but do not emit the completed answer or a duplicate completion summary before calling the tool.
default.IMPORTANT: Before calling task_complete,: IMPORTANT: When the task is done, put the complete user-facing answer in task_complete.summary, not a recap of having answered. It is shown as normal assistant text after the tool succeeds; do not emit the same completion summary separately before calling the tool.

cocopi.chatInstructionsRegexReplacements.description: Regex pattern-to-replacement entries applied to chat instruction text. User entries add new patterns or override default patterns by using the same key. An empty replacement removes matches for a custom pattern; set a default pattern to an empty string to disable that built-in replacement.

default.Do not restate the summary in your messa: Put the complete user-facing answer in this tool's summary field, not a recap of having answered. Include the requested explanation, code, links, and caveats, or the work outcome and validation as appropriate. It is shown as normal assistant text after the tool succeeds. Keep useful progress updates during work, but do not emit the completed answer separately before calling the tool.
default.Provide a brief summary of what was acco: Provide the complete user-facing answer in summary.
default.IMPORTANT: Before calling this tool, you: IMPORTANT: Supply the complete user-facing answer in summary when calling this tool. Do not separately emit the completed answer before the call.
default.^Brief summary of what was accomplished\: The complete user-facing answer, including requested details, code, links, and caveats, or the work outcome and validation. Not a recap of having answered.

cocopi.chatToolDescriptionRegexReplaceme.description: Regex pattern-to-replacement entries applied to VS Code tool descriptions. User entries add new patterns or override default patterns by using the same key. An empty replacement removes matches for a custom pattern; set a default pattern to an empty string to disable that built-in replacement.

cocopi.chatParticipantModelSource.description: Model source for @cocopi chat participant requests.
enumDescriptions: Use VS Code's currently selected Cocopi chat model for @cocopi requests, falling back to cocopi.model when the selected model is not from Cocopi.
Always use the cocopi.model setting for @cocopi requests.

cocopi.compactionFallbackStrategy.description: Compaction threshold to use when no model-provided limit is available, or when model-provided limits are disabled.
enumDescriptions: Use 90% of the usable input budget after reserving max output tokens.
Use the model context window minus max output tokens, delaying VS Code compaction until near the hard limit.

cocopi.debugLevel.description: Controls privacy-safe Cocopi output-channel diagnostics for Codex response handling.
enumDescriptions: Do not write response debug diagnostics.
Write response completion metadata, usage/cache counters when present, and unknown response keys.
Also write each Responses stream event type. Does not log prompts, output text, tokens, or account ids.
Write full request, wire request, stream event, and failure payload JSON. This can include prompt and output text; auth tokens are still redacted.

cocopi.editProgressIntervalMs.description: Milliseconds between elapsed-time edit progress updates while streamed edit tool arguments are still being generated. Set to 0 to disable timed edit progress.

cocopi.issueTracking.description: Enable private Cocopi diagnostic entries for runtime anomalies and cache diagnostics.

cocopi.inlineCompletions.enabled.description: Enable Cocopi AI inline completions. When enabled, Cocopi sends limited editor context around the cursor to the selected Codex model as you type.

cocopi.inlineCompletions.model.description: Codex model id for Cocopi AI inline completions. Auto prefers GPT-6 Luna from the signed-in catalog, then GPT-6 Sol, then cocopi.model. A specific id remains pinned.

cocopi.inlineCompletions.maxPrefixCharac.description: Maximum characters before the cursor to send with Cocopi inline completion requests.

cocopi.inlineCompletions.maxSuffixCharac.description: Maximum characters after the cursor to send with Cocopi inline completion requests.

cocopi.inlineCompletions.timeoutMs.description: Milliseconds to wait for a Cocopi inline completion stream before timing out. Set to 0 to disable the inline completion idle timeout.

cocopi.clientVersion.description: Codex client version reported to the backend in model-catalog queries and request headers. Leave unchanged unless testing a backend compatibility gate.

cocopi.model.description: Codex model id to request by default.

cocopi.routes.autocomplete.model.description: Concrete Codex target for the specialized cocopi/autocomplete workload model. Leave blank to use cocopi.inlineCompletions.model as a compatibility fallback. Workload aliases and :fast variants are not valid targets.

cocopi.routes.autocomplete.reasoningEffo.description: Reasoning effort for the specialized autocomplete workload model. Lowest selects the least effort supported by its resolved model.

cocopi.routes.autocomplete.serviceTier.description: Processing tier for the specialized autocomplete workload model.

cocopi.routes.utility.model.description: Concrete Codex target for cocopi/utility. Auto follows the catalog, preferring GPT-6 Luna; a specific id stays pinned. Workload aliases and :fast variants are not valid targets.

cocopi.routes.utility.reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort for the specialized general utility workload model. Lowest selects the least effort supported by its resolved model.

cocopi.routes.utility.serviceTier.description: Processing tier for the specialized general utility workload model.

cocopi.routes.utilitySmall.model.description: Concrete Codex target for cocopi/utility-small. Auto follows the catalog, preferring GPT-6 Luna; a specific id stays pinned. Workload aliases and :fast variants are not valid targets.

cocopi.routes.utilitySmall.reasoningEffo.description: Reasoning effort for the specialized small utility workload model. Lowest selects the least effort supported by its resolved model.

cocopi.routes.utilitySmall.serviceTier.description: Processing tier for the specialized small utility workload model.

cocopi.reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort for Cocopi requests. Request-specific model options still override this setting.
enumDescriptions: Use the model catalog default when available.
No reasoning.
Minimal reasoning.
Fast responses with lighter reasoning.
Balances speed and reasoning depth for everyday tasks.
Greater reasoning depth for complex problems.
Extra high reasoning depth for complex problems.
Maximum reasoning depth for the hardest problems.
Proactive VS Code subagent orchestration, including parallel delegation, when runSubagent and the model catalog permit it. Sends Max as the wire reasoning effort.

cocopi.reasoningSummary.description: Reasoning summary behavior for Cocopi requests. Request-specific model options still override this setting.
enumDescriptions: Use Codex auto summary mode to show the most detailed available reasoning summaries when the model supports them.
Use the model catalog default when available.
Do not show reasoning summaries.
Show concise reasoning summaries.
Show detailed reasoning summaries.

cocopi.serviceTier.description: Advanced processing tier override for Cocopi requests.
enumDescriptions: Standard processing.
Flexible processing when available.
Priority processing when available.

cocopi.streamIdleTimeoutMs.description: Milliseconds to wait for Responses stream activity before timing out. Set to 0 to disable the idle timeout.

cocopi.tokenTracking.description: Enable Cocopi Token Tracker entries for token usage and prompt-cache behavior.

cocopi.showTokenTrackerTimeline.description: Show Token Tracker timeline graphs for local usage and speed over time. This only controls display; use cocopi.tokenTracking to enable or disable recording Token Tracker rows.

cocopi.tokenTrackerTimelineDays.description: Local calendar days shown in Token Tracker timeline graphs. Stored timestamps remain UTC; graph buckets use local calendar time so daylight-saving changes are represented correctly.

enumDescriptions: Show unified local usage and speed graphs averaged across all models and reasoning settings.
Show graphs split by selected model and reasoning settings.
Show both unified and model/reasoning split graphs.

cocopi.toolStrict.description: Send VS Code tool schemas to Codex with strict structured-output validation enabled. Request-specific tool options can override this setting.

cocopi.transport.description: Responses transport used for Codex requests.
enumDescriptions: Use the HTTP/SSE Responses transport.
Use the Responses WebSocket transport.

cocopi.workerTransport.description: Receive Codex WebSocket/SSE responses in a worker while the extension host is busy. Protects stream reception, not UI rendering. Uses bounded private temporary response storage. Requires direct network access; VS Code proxy and certificate patches are not inherited. Worker failures are reported without silently switching transport or replaying a generation.

cocopi.useModelDefaultCompactionLimit.description: Use the model-provided auto_compact_token_limit as VS Code's compaction threshold when available.

description: VS Code extension that bridges VS Code Chat with Codex backend servers.
name: cocopi

scripts.assets:render: npm run assets:status-font && npx --yes @resvg/resvg-js-cli --fit-width 128 media/icon.svg media/icon.png && npx --yes @resvg/resvg-js-cli media/promo.svg media/promo.png
scripts.assets:status-font: npx --yes svgtofont --sources media/status-icons --output out/status-font --fontName cocopi && node -e "fs.copyFileSync('out/status-font/cocopi.woff', 'media/cocopi.woff')"
scripts.package:check: npm run types && node scripts/check-package.js && npm pack --dry-run
scripts.package:vsix: npm run types && node scripts/check-package.js && node scripts/package-vsix.js
scripts.types: node -e "fs.rmSync('types', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.types.json
scripts.validate: npm run check && npm run lint && npm run package:check && npm run coverage
